raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Deterministic mode checked only `--attention-backend`, but this does not guarantee that prefill and decode attention are deterministic: `--prefill-attention-backend` and `--decode-attention-backend` override it for their phase, and they were not checked. This PR adds the check for both flags. Without it, deterministic mode could be on while prefill or decode used a backend that is not deterministic, with no warning.

For example, on MI350X this starts without an error and runs AITER's paged-attention kernels for decode, although `aiter` is not on the deterministic list:

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --attention-backend triton --decode-attention-backend aiter \
  --enable-deterministic-inference
```

The same applies on every platform and to any backend outside the list (for example `flashmla` or `trtllm_mha` for one phase on NVIDIA).

AITER decode attention is in fact batch-invariant on gfx950; #44489 allows it there on top of this PR, with the evidence. This PR only makes deterministic mode check the per-phase flags at all.

## Modifications

- `_deterministic_attention_backend` (in `arg_groups/overrides.py`): in deterministic mode, also check `prefill_attention_backend` and `decode_attention_backend` against `DETERMINISTIC_ATTENTION_BACKEND_CHOICES` when they are set. The error names the flag and the backend.
- `test_model_overrides.py`:
  - a non-deterministic backend in either per-phase flag is refused, even when `--attention-backend` is on the list;
  - per-phase backends that are on the list are accepted.
- Unchanged:
  - deterministic mode off;
  - per-phase flags unset (the existing fallback for `--attention-backend` is untouched);
  - which backends are on the list.
- Scope: the check runs where deterministic mode is resolved, so it covers per-phase backends that are set explicitly or by model-specific defaults before it. Two later automatic choices are not covered here:
  - the NVFP4 KV-cache prefill/decode pair;
  - CuteDSL MLA's `trtllm_mla` prefill pairing.

  Both are tied to opt-in features (NVFP4 KV cache, CuteDSL MLA decode). Covering them needs a check after those passes; I'd leave that to a follow-up.
- Behaviour change: configurations that combine `--enable-deterministic-inference` with a per-phase backend outside the list now fail at startup instead of running without the deterministic guarantee. This includes model defaults that set such a backend, for example Kimi-K3's backends for decode context parallelism.

## Accuracy Tests

No numerical change: this only refuses configurations at startup.

Unit tests, `python3 -m pytest test/registered/unit/test_model_overrides.py -k deterministic` (MI350X, `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm724-mi35x-20261013`): before, the new refusal test fails for both flags (2 failed, 5 passed); after, 5 passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No runtime change: the check runs once while the server arguments are resolved.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -1053,6 +1053,19 @@ def _deterministic_attention_backend(view: Any) -> dict:
         return {}
     from sglang.srt.server_args import DETERMINISTIC_ATTENTION_BACKEND_CHOICES
 
+    # A per-phase backend takes priority over --attention-backend for its phase,
+    # so it has to be one of the deterministic backends too.
+    for field in ("prefill_attention_backend", "decode_attention_backend"):
+        backend = getattr(view, field, None)
+        if (
+            backend is not None
+            and backend not in DETERMINISTIC_ATTENTION_BACKEND_CHOICES
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Currently only {DETERMINISTIC_ATTENTION_BACKEND_CHOICES} attention backends are supported for deterministic inference, "
+                f"but --{field.replace('_', '-')} is '{backend}'."
+            )
+
     if view.attention_backend is None:
         # User didn't specify attention backend, fallback based on GPU architecture
         if get_platform().is_sm100 or get_platform().is_sm120:

@@ -1735,6 +1735,42 @@ def test_deterministic_incompatible_backend_raises(self):
         with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
             _deterministic_attention_backend(view)
 
+    def test_deterministic_incompatible_phase_backend_raises(self):
+        from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import (
+            ResolvedView,
+            _deterministic_attention_backend,
+        )
+
+        # A per-phase backend overrides --attention-backend for its phase, so a
+        # non-deterministic one must be refused even when the main backend is fine.
+        for field in ("prefill_attention_backend", "decode_attention_backend"):
+            with self.subTest(field=field):
+                view = ResolvedView(
+                    SimpleNamespace(
+                        enable_deterministic_inference=True,
+                        attention_backend="triton",
+                        **{field: "aiter"},
+                    )
+                )
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, field.replace("_", "-")):
+                    _deterministic_attention_backend(view)
+
+    def test_deterministic_compatible_phase_backends_are_accepted(self):
+        from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import (
+            ResolvedView,
+            _deterministic_attention_backend,
+        )
+
+        view = ResolvedView(
+            SimpleNamespace(
+                enable_deterministic_inference=True,
+                attention_backend="triton",
+                prefill_attention_backend="triton",
+                decode_attention_backend="fa3",
+            )
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(_deterministic_attention_backend(view), {})
+
